//: SHA3-256 hashes of the official SQLite amalgamation ZIPs, as published in the
PRODUCT csv on https://sqlite.org/download.html (the final column).
scripts/sync-from-sqlite.ts REFUSES to vendor an amalgamation whose hash is not
listed here, and hard-fails on a mismatch. The vendored sqlite3.c is compiled
directly into the addon, so an unverified download is arbitrary C in our binary.
Adding an entry is a deliberate, reviewable act: verify the hash against
sqlite.org yourself, then commit it in the same PR as the amalgamation bump.
`npm run sync:sqlite -- --accept-new-checksum` records it for you, but you are
still the one attesting to it in review.
